+# Indexer Replay
+
+Enable `--enable-return-indexer-topk` to return ordinary sparse-attention
+selections through the local AuxOutput SHM connector. This path stores raw
+`int32` indices and does not use a Profile or a model-specific codec.
+
+```bash
+vllm serve deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V3.2 --enable-return-indexer-topk
+```
+
+The adapters cover DeepSeek V3.2 / GLM-5.2 DSA and their shared reference MLA
+path, plus DeepSeek V4's common GPU attention path. Dots3 NOTE also captures raw
+token selections; GLM4-MoE-Lite uses the reference path when configured for DSA.
+Support is an implementation claim pending model validation.
+
+DeepSeek V4.1, GLM-5.3 KPool, Qwen4Exp QSA, Step5 Region selection and HY-V4
+are deferred to the dependent Profile PR.
+MiniMax-M3 has no adapter. A model/backend without ordinary capture sources
+fails at startup instead of returning an empty replay.
+
+## Output
+
+Offline generation returns `CompletionOutput.indexer_topk` as an array with
+shape `[num_forwarded_tokens, num_indexer_sources, index_topk]`, dtype `int32`.
+Source planes are ordered by their actual layer IDs. IndexCache consumers
+reuse the source plane selected by the model configuration; a shared consumer
+does not create another plane. All sources must have the same TopK width.
+Order, padding and invalid IDs are preserved exactly as captured.
+
+DeepSeek V4 captures only actual C4A Indexer layers; HCA/SWA layers do not add
+planes. Its indices address the compressed KV cache and are returned unchanged,
+as consumed by Attention. They are not expanded to original token positions.
+This fixed-width raw format requires no Profile or codec.
+
+Python Chat Completions, Completions and Token-in-Token-out responses include
+`indexer_topk` on the terminal choice/chunk. The value is a base64-encoded NumPy
+`.npy` array; the field is omitted when disabled or no rows were produced.
+These are intentional vLLM extensions, absent from the
+[OpenAI OpenAPI specification](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/openai/openai-openapi/master/openapi.yaml).
+
+```python
+import base64
+import io
+
+import numpy as np
+
+indices = np.load(io.BytesIO(base64.b64decode(choice["indexer_topk"])))
+```
+
+`SamplingParams.indexer_topk_prompt_start` skips an already returned prompt
+prefix independently of `routed_experts_prompt_start`. The final sampled token
+has no selection row because it has not been forwarded yet.
+
+## Storage and limits
+
+Indexer and routed-expert return can be enabled independently or together.
+They share the existing AuxOutput block hashes, asynchronous output event,
+accepted-token cursors, prefix restoration and finish lifecycle. Model identity,
+source layers and TopK width identify the SHM namespace. R3-only storage keeps
+its existing format.
+
+The V2 model runner creates the Connector in `profile_run()`. Its constructor
+allocates and binds both capturers before the profiling forward pass, so their
+persistent device buffers enter automatic KV budgeting. Indexer snapshots are
+cloned per step at runtime instead of being pre-allocated with the buffer.
+Real KV initialization reuses the Connector and calls `initialize_output_storage()`
+after KV capacity is resolved; only the output TP rank creates SHM storage.
+Initialization paths that skip profiling retain main's Connector fallback.
+Capture buffers stay outside the weights pool. Explicit KV memory budgets remain
+manual. Shutdown releases captured graphs before unbinding Indexer capture.
+
+DeepSeek V4 replay forces backbone scoring even for short contexts so the common
+capture entry always sees freshly scored TopK. ROCm DeepSeek V4 `--monokernel`
+bypasses that entry and is rejected with `--enable-return-indexer-topk`.
+
+Indexer storage is `4 * num_indexer_sources * index_topk` bytes/token. The
+record adds the byte widths of all enabled artifacts, including routed experts.
+With the default `max_bytes`, `N` KV blocks and `B` tokens/block allocate
+`N * B * combined_bytes_per_token` bytes of SHM per output worker.
+
+MRV2 generate runner and prefix caching are required. Existing AuxOutput limits
+on PP, DCP/PCP, adaptive verification and remote PD still apply. Rust's token
+frontend accepts `sampling_params.indexer_topk_prompt_start` on
+`/inference/v1/generate`, independently of the routed-expert offset. Its LLM
+facade accumulates raw rows across engine updates and stream intervals; the
+terminal choice/chunk carries the same base64 NumPy array as Python. Disabled
+or absent Indexer data omits the field. Rust Chat/Completions artifact delivery
+is not implemented, matching its existing routed-expert support boundary.
+SHM keeps its immutable first-writer behavior. CUDA Graph, real TP/DP, model
+quality and performance require later validation. Rust compilation and route
+regressions require a Unix Rust environment; they have not run on the local
+Windows host.

+from __future__ import annotations

+class IndexerCaptureSink:
+    def __init__(self, rows: torch.Tensor) -> None:
+        self.rows = rows
+
+    def capture(self, indices: torch.Tensor, token_start: int = 0) -> None:
+        if indices.ndim != 2 or indices.shape[1] != self.rows.shape[1]:
+            raise ValueError("Indexer selection width changed")
+        end = token_start + len(indices)
+        if token_start < 0 or end > len(self.rows):
+            raise ValueError("Indexer selection exceeds capture token capacity")
+        if not len(indices):
+            return
+        self.rows[token_start:end].copy_(indices)
+
+
+def capture_indexer_topk(
+    sink: IndexerCaptureSink | None,
+    topk_indices_buffer: torch.Tensor | None,
+    num_tokens: int,
+) -> None:
+    if sink is None:
+        return
+    assert topk_indices_buffer is not None
+    # DBO ubatches share the parent batch's capture rows, so each ubatch writes
+    # at its own offset instead of overwriting row 0.
+    sink.capture(
+        topk_indices_buffer[:num_tokens, : sink.rows.shape[1]],
+        token_start=dbo_current_ubatch_token_offset(),
+    )
+
+
+class IndexerCaptureSource:
+    """Explicit capability for a logical TopK producer's execution path."""
+
+    indexer_capture: IndexerCaptureSink | None = None
+
+    def get_indexer_capture_metadata(self) -> tuple[int, int] | None:
+        """Return (layer_id, topk), or None for a shared-index consumer."""
+        raise NotImplementedError
+
+    def set_indexer_capture_sink(self, sink: IndexerCaptureSink | None) -> None:
+        self.indexer_capture = sink
+
+
+def _get_indexer_capture_sources(
+    model: torch.nn.Module, num_layers: int
+) -> list[tuple[int, int, IndexerCaptureSource]]:
+    sources: list[tuple[int, int, IndexerCaptureSource]] = []
+    for module in model.modules():
+        if not isinstance(module, IndexerCaptureSource):
+            continue
+        metadata = module.get_indexer_capture_metadata()
+        if metadata is None:
+            continue
+        layer_id, topk = metadata
+        if layer_id >= num_layers:
+            continue
+        sources.append((layer_id, topk, module))
+    sources.sort(key=lambda entry: entry[0])
+    if not sources:
+        raise ValueError(
+            "No backbone indexer capture sources: this model/backend "
+            "does not support ordinary indexer replay"
+        )
+    layer_ids = tuple(layer_id for layer_id, _, _ in sources)
+    topks = {topk for _, topk, _ in sources}
+    if (
+        min(layer_ids) < 0
+        or len(set(layer_ids)) != len(layer_ids)
+        or len(topks) != 1
+        or min(topks) <= 0
+    ):
+        raise ValueError(
+            "Ordinary indexer replay requires unique layers and uniform positive topk"
+        )
+    return sources
+
+
+class IndexerCapturer:
+    """Own raw storage and snapshots for the discovered source layout."""
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        model: torch.nn.Module,
+        config: VllmConfig,
+        *,
+        output_rank: bool = True,
+    ) -> None:
+        sources = _get_indexer_capture_sources(
+            model, config.model_config.get_total_num_hidden_layers()
+        )
+        for layer_id, _, source in sources:
+            if source.indexer_capture is not None:
+                raise ValueError(
+                    f"Indexer capture source layer {layer_id} is already bound"
+                )
+        layer_ids = tuple(layer_id for layer_id, _, _ in sources)
+        topk = sources[0][1]
+        self.shape_per_token = (len(layer_ids), topk)
+        self.fixed_bytes_per_token = len(layer_ids) * topk * 4
+        self._bindings: list[tuple[IndexerCaptureSource, IndexerCaptureSink]] = []
+        self._closed = False
+        model_config = config.model_config
+        identity = json.dumps(
+            {
+                "format": "indexer-int32-v1",
+                "layer_ids": layer_ids,
+                "topk": topk,
+                "model": model_config.model,
+                "revision": model_config.revision,
+                "commit": getattr(model_config.hf_config, "_commit_hash", None),
+                "code_revision": model_config.code_revision,
+                "config": model_config.hf_text_config.to_dict(),
+                "dtype": str(model_config.dtype),
+                "quantization": model_config.quantization,
+            },
+            sort_keys=True,
+            default=str,
+        )
+        self.namespace = hashlib.sha256(identity.encode()).hexdigest()
+        self._output_rank = output_rank
+        self.device_buffer = torch.empty(
+            (
+                config.scheduler_config.max_num_batched_tokens,
+                *self.shape_per_token,
+            ),
+            dtype=torch.int32,
+            device=config.device_config.device,
+        )
+
+        try:
+            for column, (_, _, source) in enumerate(sources):
+                sink = IndexerCaptureSink(self.device_buffer[:, column])
+                self._bindings.append((source, sink))
+                source.set_indexer_capture_sink(sink)
+        except BaseException:
+            self.close()
+            raise
+
+    def snapshot(self, num_rows: int) -> torch.Tensor:
+        """Copy the forwarded rows into a snapshot owned by the caller."""
+        assert self._output_rank, "Indexer snapshots require the output rank"
+        assert 0 <= num_rows <= len(self.device_buffer)
+        return self.device_buffer[:num_rows].clone()
+
+    def close(self) -> None:
+        """Unbind this capturer's sinks and release its buffers."""
+        if self._closed:
+            return
+        for source, sink in reversed(self._bindings):
+            if source.indexer_capture is sink:
+                source.set_indexer_capture_sink(None)
+        self._bindings.clear()
+        del self.device_buffer
+        self._closed = True
